8. 在某公司，37.5% 的僱員為女性。若 60% 的男僱員及 80% 的女僱員均已婚，則該公司中已婚僱員所佔的百分數為
A. 32.5%
B. 45%
C. 55%
D. 67.5%
reasoning: Let total employees = 100. Female = 37.5%, married female = 80% of 37.5% = 30%. Male = 62.5%, married male = 60% of 62.5% = 37.5%. Total married = 30% + 37.5% = 67.5%, which matches option D.
